outputCalibration.source: Exact equally weighted development-season actual-vs-predicted slopes; read unrounded pooled values, not displayed decimals.
outputCalibration.formula: Within each season/K, subtract the30-team mean from the20-seed mean predicted net; multiply by frozen m4[K] or ms[K]. No team/season refit, no new simulation. For joint seed bootstrap scale the re-averaged seed prediction; team resample then recenters for evaluation.
outputCalibration.undefinedReason: Output transformation supplies no win/game-event/box forecast. Leave undefined values null, never fabricate wins or treat them as zero.

evaluation.interpretation: All verdicts use joint franchise+seed bootstrap only. No old B1 temporal slope rule and no old C2 two-cutoff pass criterion.

jointBootstrap.franchiseCoupling: Same franchise sample shared across all seasons and all versions; same paired seed sample shared across seasons. Recenter net within each season. Seasons equally weighted; netRMSE/winRMSE pool MSE then sqrt; other metrics arithmetic mean.

evaluation.strongerComparator: For each K/group and each error metric, evaluation envelope=min(combined simple error,combined shrink error); recompute the envelope within each joint bootstrap draw. Both fixed predictors individually also reported. No choice enters engine forecasts.
evaluation.verdict: At each K using only the two blind seasons combined: 成立 if either primary error (netRMSE or winMAE) has jointCI upper<0. Report any significant worsening of the other error as a tradeoff. 不成立 if neither improves and at least one has jointCI lower>0. 分不出 if both intervals include0, and report both widths. Also report each endpoint verdict. No point-estimate claims when 分不出; no K pooling or new majority threshold.
evaluation.primaryReport: Four-season combined, alongside blind-two-season combined; only blind-two-season combined establishes C4. Single seasons descriptive. No refitting/version changes after seeing blind results.
evaluation.C5: Compute actual-vs-predicted calibration-slope ratios v4/simple and v3/simple in each new season/cutoff, compare descriptively to developer-season values; oracle ratios are never forecast inputs.

bootstrap.coupling: 30 franchises and20 paired seeds sampled with replacement, draws shared across all versions and seasons. Within-season recentering, equal season weight; RMSE and oracle RMSE pool squared errors before sqrt; other metrics average seasonal quantities. Recompute stronger-comparator error envelope in each draw.

evaluation.perCutoffVerdict: For(a)-(e), retain B4 OR rule on netRMSE/winMAE95% intervals; for(f)-(h), use netRMSE alone. 成立 if any applicable primary error upper95<0; 不成立 if none improves and any lower95>0; otherwise 分不出. Significant opposite-endpoint worsening remains an explicit tradeoff.

confirmation.perEndpoint: Cross-season confirmation if same endpoint/direction has95% CI excluding0 at>=2 distinct K, or99.8% CI excluding0 at anyK. One K at95% only is single-point. None is unresolved.
confirmation.perComparison: Retain B4 primary-error OR: for each direction, count distinctK with any applicable primary endpoint in that direction. >=2 suchK OR any endpoint at99.8% gives 跨季確認; exactly1K at95% only gives 單點成立; none gives 分不出. Endpoint-specific grades and all opposite-direction results are also shown.
confirmation.singlePointWarning: 30多個檢定中預期約1–2個偶然通過
confirmation.conclusionRestriction: Only comparisons with improvement direction 跨季確認 may be described as improving. Single-point and unresolved may not use point estimates to claim improvement. Only blind-two-season combined establishes C4; four-season/development tables are descriptive.

quality.denominator: 1230 official regular-season games,30 teams each82. Strict audit excludes missingPbp, lineup failure, possession uncertainty and official counter mismatch.
quality.belowThreshold: Still run and mark 覆蓋不足. Also report all-season and blind-only aggregates excluding every season below85%; no silent exclusion or manual fixes.
quality.inSeasonTournament2023: Only official Regular Season leaguegamelog schedule is admitted. Tournament group games, quarterfinals and semifinals count; championship game does not. Assert1230 games and82 per team; list excluded finals and tournament schedule checks in audit.
quality.failures: Publish complete gameID reasons, team/month counts and cross-tab; minute/counter tolerances remain frozen.

diagnostics.label: 事後探索，不作驗收
diagnostics.oracle: Report each of four seasons original v4/simple oracle slopes and their ratios, compare to frozen development values. Never feed blind oracle values into forecasts.

ablation.base: v4 workflow at each of four seasons and3 calendar cutoffs; reuse first3 existing v4 seeds as control.

components.offensePrior: Set role priorOffense to training-minute weighted league mean before frozen projection; retain offenseResidual and all defense.
components.offenseResidual: Set role offenseResidual to zero before frozen projection; retain prior and defense.
components.defenseSignals: Disable learned rebound/rim/live/zone/foul signal switches only; retain all event mechanisms and v4 card projection. Label that this excludes the separately embedded role-defense projection.
components.minutes: Set every player seasonMinutesPerGame to20; existing per-game target normalization gives equal targets among available players; same actual active lists/starters.

ablation.calibration: Reuse each cutoff v4 training-only calibration unchanged; no re-estimation for ablation and no heldout tuning.
ablation.quantities: Population variance of30-team mean predicted net. Report V(all)-V(component-off), marginal share relative to V(all), and RMS net change. Marginal shares need not sum to100% because of interactions/covariance and3-seed noise; do not portray them as an additive causal decomposition. Also report a covariance bookkeeping decomposition Cov(net,delta_i)/Var(net) plus residual term so the algebra sums to100%, clearly labelled exploratory rather than causal.

stoppingRule: Complete C0–C5, report facts/speculation/failures, then stop; no next batch. Frozen v1/v3/v4/v5 workflows, m4/ms,c(K) and verdicts may not change after blind downloads. Execution-only adapters and explicitly recorded transport/serialization fixes may not change estimation or prediction rules.
